integrator_questions: Does the final controller keep oval finish rate at or near 1.0 and s-bend finishes above the iteration-10 level of 9 of 20?
Where does the first s-bend line loss occur, and does steering_oscillation (iteration 10 0.37) stay controlled?
Is any bend failure a wheel-command saturation limit at plus or minus 4095? Please report the count if nonzero.
What is completion_time on oval finishes, and does speed margin allow a higher base_speed?

intent: Hold the iteration-10 geometry unchanged for the final race, so the Integrator's controller is the only variable. I kept the five-sensor 50 mm span at y = 0.075 m with a 12 mm footprint, since every change to span, footprint, forward position, track width or mass tested so far either cost oval finishes or left bend line loss unchanged. I am not testing wheel_track 0.14 m, because the s-bend line_loss_events of 1.5 is below the 2.0 condition the Integrator set. I expect a score near the iteration-10 value of about 546, with the s-bend the main weakness and any further gain coming from control.
learning: Hypotheses: (1) the iteration-10 gain came from control, so the controller remains the main lever for the s-bend; (2) s-bend line loss at 1.5 is below the level that justified track widening, so geometry is adequate for the development tracks; (3) on the unseen final track, a robust, unchanged geometry is preferable to an untested change. Measurements requested per track: completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, max_error, line_loss_events, steering_oscillation and control_effort. line_loss_events on the bends shows whether control changes help, and completion_time shows the speed margin.
rationale:
The best raced design is iteration 10 (546.4), built on the iteration-9 geometry: five sensors at x = -0.025 to +0.025 m, y = 0.075 m, 12 mm footprint, wheel_track 0.12 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m, body 0.18 x 0.12 m, mass 0.5 kg. Its gain came from the controller change, not geometry. The oval finished 20 of 20, slalom line loss fell from 3.0 to 2.1, and the s-bend reached 9 of 20 finishes with line_loss_events of 1.5.

The Integrator's advice was conditional. Wheel_track 0.14 m was to be tested only if s-bend line_loss_events stayed at 2.0 or more with the oval finish rate near 1.0. The raced s-bend line loss is now 1.5, below that threshold, and the oval finish rate is 1.0. The condition is not met, so I did not take the exploratory track change. I took the Integrator's advice to hold geometry and kept the 50 mm span, forward position, footprint and body width, since these were shown to cost oval finishes when changed.

This is the final iteration, so an untested geometry change would be scored on the unseen track with no later chance to correct it. Holding the best-evidenced geometry is the lowest-risk choice. Expected result: the geometry is unchanged, so any change in score comes from the Integrator's controller. The score should stay near the iteration-10 level, with the s-bend the main remaining weakness.
